name: The Arrabelle, Vail Square
positioning: The Arrabelle at Vail Square, A RockResort: a European-style alpine resort on Lionshead's main square in Vail, with ski-in/ski-out access to Vail Mountain
best_for: Skiers who want to be steps from the Eagle Bahn Gondola
Families or groups wanting a residence with a full kitchen and laundry

facts.text: The Arrabelle is a ski-in/ski-out resort in Lionshead Village, steps from the Eagle Bahn Gondola with direct access to Vail Mountain.
The hotel is managed by Vail Resorts under the RockResorts banner.
The facade layers creamy stucco with rough-cut stone, arched windows and timber Juliet balconies, with roughly two dozen hand-painted alpine murals.
The lobby has high ceilings with exposed wood beams and iron chandeliers.
Hotel rooms have carved-wood headboards, gas fireplaces with hand-painted murals and balconies facing either the Gore Range or Lionshead Square.
Private residences range from one to five bedrooms.
The residences have full kitchens, dining areas, living rooms with fireplaces and laundry.
The hotel has a RockResorts Spa, and its locker rooms include a steam room and a sauna.
The hotel has rooftop hot tubs and a lap pool.
Tavern on the Square is the hotel's main restaurant, opening directly onto Lionshead's main plaza.
There is a summer amphitheater with featured concerts.
Guests have access to the Red Sky Golf Club.

highlights.text: The rooftop pool deck is heated year-round, with a hot tub facing the mountains.
The hotel offers a slopeside ski and boot valet and equipment storage service, plus a ski concierge.
The Arrabelle has a plaza with an open-air ice rink in winter, plus year-round shopping, dining and apres-ski just outside the door.
A sky bridge connects the hotel's buildings, with views of the ice skating rink and the mountain.
Each residence has its own decor, with artwork, textiles and furniture that vary.

considerations.text: Plaza-facing rooms can catch noise during peak season; mountain-view rooms are recommended.
The concierge can arrange dinner reservations and private ski instructors; peak-season requests need advance notice.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing and peak winter demand.
